text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Fully get into character as a master archer?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Just regular horseback archery would be boring, right?
I thought getting fully into character as an archer would make it feel way more immersive!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And besides! Since I get to run with the Prez, I want this to be an extra-special practice♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see. So that's why the racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just the right mindset can help hit the mark.
It might be worth a try.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Tsuru-chan!
As for how to do it, you go like this, and like that—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear ye! I am the Emperor whose name
echoes across the realm—here I come!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A-Alright, me too...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll shoot straight through my chosen target—
with a steadfast heart!
(*swish-swish-swish――!*)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So this is what they mean by 'versatile mastery.'
Both of you showed truly magnificent skill.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I'm hitting the target more than usual!
Is this the power of getting into character...?!'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then—following your example,
I shall run as a fellow martial artist.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "True aim never misses"――For the "Emperor's" arrow, a second shot "never" exists.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!?
Dead center, from that far away...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. One shot, one soul, is it...?
Perhaps the archers of old
were searching for that 'true' single arrow.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So... so coo—

text_block_list.name: Secret Spectators
text_block_list.text: —So cooool~~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! When did so many
students gather around...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Well, naturally~♪ Who could ever leave such a dignified President all alone—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You three drawing your bows looks truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"It was like a hero reborn in modern times...
Our hearts were totally stolen, ya know!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
U-Us too...!?
Um, thank you very much!
Tsuyoshi will do her very best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~n♪ Right, right?!
The great Teio-sama never misses her target~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It just goes to show that if you keep putting in tireless effort, someone is sure to take notice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue our practice.
Like a master archer... with the spirit of the benevolent marksman.
